title: SIU probes fatal shooting of Brampton man
article: An official probe was launched yesterday into the shooting death of a middle-aged man by police officers from Peel Region.

Eight people will examine the circumstances of the shooting, which occurred Monday night, for the province's Special Investigations Unit. According to an SIU statement on the initial investigation, 54-year-old Ronald Smith was killed after "a confrontation" with police.

The officers arrived at a home on Ramblers Drive in Brampton at about 11:30 p.m. to enforce outstanding warrants. Shots were fired by one officer and, about 90 minutes later, the man was pronounced dead at Peel hospital.

Officers from Peel Region were cleared last week in another fatal shooting that took place in January. In that case, a tactical squad burst into a Caledon home and fired a total of nine shots at a man who had refused to drop his firearm. Killed at the scene was Rajesh Owaan who, the investigation later showed, had fired once at police.
